title: Student can complete the assessment and see a Learning Profile
description: This verifies that a student can answer the assessment, submit it, and receive generated profile results.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts/login/
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link or button to continue to onboarding
Continue to the assessment
Select an answer for each assessment question
Submit the completed assessment
Verify the Learning Profile results are displayed
Verify an archetype and dimension bars are shown

title: Teacher can create a class and see its shareable code
description: This verifies that a signed-in teacher can create a class from the dashboard and receive a generated class code.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts/login/
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /classroom/
Fill in the class name field with a valid class name
Create the class
Verify the new class appears in the dashboard
Verify a 6-character class code is displayed

title: Student can register as a student and access the platform
description: This verifies that a new student can create an account with the student role and reach authenticated access.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts/register/
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Select the student role
Submit the registration form
Verify authenticated access is available
Verify the student account registration is successful

title: Student can log in to an existing account
description: This verifies that a registered student can sign in and reach authenticated parts of the platform.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts/login/
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify authenticated access is available
Verify the user lands on the platform after signing in

title: Student can view onboarding before starting the assessment
description: This verifies that an authenticated student can open onboarding and continue into the assessment flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts/login/
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form

Verify the onboarding introduction is displayed
Verify the assessment entry point is available

title: Student can join a class with a valid code and see it in joined classes
description: This verifies that a student can join a teacher’s class using a valid 6-character code and see the class reflected afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts/login/
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /classroom/join/
Enter a valid 6-character class code
Join the class
Verify the class join succeeds
Verify the joined class appears in the student’s enrolled classes

title: Student sees validation when required registration fields are missing
description: This verifies that registration does not proceed when required student account fields are omitted.

Leave the full name field empty
Leave the email field empty
Leave the password field empty
Select the student role
Submit the registration form
Verify form validation errors are visible
Verify the account is not created

Submit the login form
